subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured duration/start-end contract, and which reported event types should become lifecycle spans versus remain point-in-time events?
rationale: Current main and docs expose trajectory rows as events, while OTel already has some duration-bearing spans and some zero-duration point spans; changing this safely creates a public diagnostic schema and dashboard contract.

options.title: Define trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design/fix that adds measured timing to real lifecycle operations while documenting point events.

options.title: Limit fix to OTel latency work
options.body: Let the open OTel latency decomposition PR handle context/reply timing and explicitly document trajectory JSONL as event-only.

options.title: Split runtime and transcript events
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle spans separately from transcript-derived tool events so each surface can use the right schema without overloading this issue.

recommendation.title: Define trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design/fix that adds measured timing to real lifecycle operations while documenting point events.
